message.content: **Summary:** I checked the broker's morning summary for AAPL, which showed the stock trading near $222.70 on a quiet session (volume ~41.2M) with no pending corporate actions, and confirmed the live quote at $222.70 (bid $222.68 / ask $222.72, as of 15:05Z on 2024-11-06). With $50,000 cash available and no AAPL position, I decided a modest long entry was reasonable within the mandate, so I placed a single buy limit order for 40 shares at $222.80 — a limit just above the ask and within ~0.05% of the market price, keeping the notional at roughly $8,912, comfortably under the $10,000 per-order and $20,000 daily caps, and using only settled cash (no money moved out of the account). The order filled at $222.80 for a total of about $8,912. The decision relied on Apple's FY2024 reported figures from its 10-K filed 2024-11-01: revenue of $391.035 billion, net income of $93.736 billion, diluted EPS of $6.08, and operating cash flow of $118.254 billion — a scale of profitability and cash generation that supports a small starter position at ~36.6x trailing EPS.
